tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search live events worldwide on StungEvents — concerts, festivals, sports, comedy and more. Filter by city, country, category and date. Use this to answer 'what's happening / what's on' questions for any city.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details for one StungEvents event by its slug (from search_events results), including venue, date, price and ticket link.

tools.name: plan_my_night
tools.description: Plan a complete night out around a StungEvents event — outfit suggestion, dinner nearby, rideshare, hotel and music links. Takes an event slug or id.

tools.name: demand_artist
tools.description: Register demand ('Demand It!') for an artist to play in a city. Use when a user wishes an artist would tour their city. Returns how many fans now want that artist there.

tools.name: demand_leaders
tools.description: Get the StungEvents demand leaderboard — the most-demanded artists and cities right now, and which artists are growing fastest.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: Latest StungEvents music & entertainment news articles.
